title: Hilbert curves order map tiles on disk
body: Because the Hilbert curve maps a line onto a plane while mostly keeping neighbours near each other, systems like Google's S2 geometry index the Earth by chopping it into Hilbert-ordered cells. A pure-mathematics curiosity from 1891 became production infrastructure for planetary search. Locality preservation is cash when your database is a planet.
